scientific.integrity: The correction is derived from the source equilibrium identity and the exact symbolic Jacobian. The primary full PDF and a highly relevant full-text predecessor on hierarchical cell-production stability were inspected. The standalone checker replays the factorization and witness with exact algebra. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The complete local-stability classification is for the ordinary differential-equation model. The corrected Jacobian also underlies the fractional formulation, but no complete Atangana-Baleanu-Caputo fractional stability criterion is asserted. The result is local and does not resolve the nonhyperbolic equality cases.

title: Corrected invasion spectrum for the no-stem/no-progenitor equilibrium in a four-stage cell lineage
